description:
The last of humankind, floating through space on a technological ark.   
A peaceful city with no gods or heroes is swept up in a coup from the dungeons...

A futuristic Three Kingdoms epic in which humanity has lost its planet and is drifting through space.

[Pre-serialization](https://comic.naver.com/bestChallenge/list?titleId=634663)

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=10502152), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000061048), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/modern_fiction_a), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/63332969), [Toptoon](https://toptoon.com/comic/ep_list/Modern_Fiction_A)
